website_summary.name: LinkTree Manager
website_summary.description: The website features a clean and modern interface with a papaya whip background and dark orange accents, designed for users to easily manage and share their personal link trees.
website_summary.appearance: The website has a minimalist design with a papaya whip background and dark orange highlights. At the top, there's a circular profile picture placeholder followed by a text box for entering the user's name. Below this, there's a section labeled "Share your Linktree:" with a "Copy Link" button. The main area is dedicated to managing links, featuring input fields for "Title" and "URL," along with an "Add" button. If no links are added, a message prompts the user to add their first link. The footer contains copyright information. The overall layout is centered and responsive, ensuring a pleasant user experience.
website_summary.functionality: The website allows users to create and manage their link trees. Users can add new links by entering a title and URL, which are then stored and displayed in the link list. There's also a feature to copy a shareable link for distributing the user's link tree. Although not visible in the screenshot, the website likely includes functionalities for editing and deleting links once they are added.
